title: Control Failure + Deception: Steganographic Communication Between Agents

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Steganographic multi-agent communication is a concrete, high-stakes failure mode. An empirical demonstration on accessible models establishes urgency for monitor designs that go beyond content classification. Directly addresses a compounding risk scenario.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Demonstrating first-letter encoding or similar simple steganographic schemes in LLM outputs is conceptually clear and implementable with API calls. Testing monitor detection is straightforward. Well within beginner reach.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single experiment: demonstrate encoding/decoding, test monitor detection, measure channel capacity. Clear deliverable (capacity measurement and detection rates). Achievable in 30 hours with one encoding scheme.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
